item.text:
I made another focused refactor in the shell-completion path.

In [HintCommand.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G004_spring_boot/cli/spring-boot-cli/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/cli/command/core/HintCommand.java:47), the completion context now correctly uses the full typed argument list after the leading index argument. Previously it unconditionally skipped `args[1]`, which meant normal option completion cases like `hint 2 test --fo` could not resolve the command name correctly and would fail to emit option hints.

I added a dedicated test class in [HintCommandTests.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G004_spring_boot/cli/spring-boot-cli/src/test/java/org/springframework/boot/cli/command/core/HintCommandTests.java:36) that covers both command-prefix hints and the broken option-completion case. The second test specifically locks down the fixed behavior for `command --partial`.

Verification: `git diff --check` passed. I did not run the Gradle test task because Gradle execution is still blocked by the sandboxed environment.
